result.title: Bidirectional Centered Score Matching for Discrete Diffusion Distillation
result.summary: Discrete diffusion models with parallel decoding are often distilled using token-wise KL objectives. Although token-wise KL exactly matches the corresponding product-form block distributions, its probability-space optimization geometry and teacher-only candidate truncation may provide insufficient supervision under aggressive few-step distillation. Concrete Score Matching (CSM) provides an alternative within-position objective by aligning relative logit geometry, but its complete pairwise form incurs $\mathcal{O}(|\mathcal{V}|^2)$ complexity. We propose Bidirectional Centered Score Matching (BCSM), an efficient within-position distillation objective that constructs an $\mathcal{O}(K)$ bidirectional active set, reduces pairwise comparisons to $\mathcal{O}(K^2)$, and factorizes them into an $\mathcal{O}(K)$ objective. We further introduce cross-timestep transition alignment. Experiments demonstrate strong quality--efficiency trade-offs, including up to $6\times$ NFE reduction with a 16.9\% relative HumanEval gain and a 15.1\% relative MMMU gain at single-step inference.

AI.brief_summary: 针对离散扩散模型的少步蒸馏，指出 token-wise KL 的概率空间优化几何与教师端候选截断监督不足，提出 Bidirectional Centered Score Matching：以 O(K) 双向活跃集把成对比较降至 O(K^2) 并进一步分解为 O(K) 目标，并加入跨时间步转移对齐，报告了质量—效率折中及 MMMU 等基准上的相对提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 不直接研究视觉推理或多模态 latent 状态，但其中的分数匹配式分布对齐与跨时间步监督，可能为 parallel/diffusion 式少步推理的蒸馏与轨迹监督提供可核查线索。
